features: Amorphous, finely granular and vacuolated eosinophilic necrotic material
Wavy bundles of residual collagen within the necrotic zone
Scattered degenerated, smudged nuclei and nuclear debris
No viable granulomatous rim, giant cells or organisms visible in this field
62523.describe_en: High-power H&E shows predominantly amorphous, finely granular and vacuolated necrotic material containing wavy residual collagen bundles and scattered degenerated nuclei and nuclear debris. No viable epithelioid histiocytes, giant cells or organisms are identified in this field. The appearance represents the central necrotic zone of a necrotizing granulomatous process; in isolation it is nonspecific, and correlation with the palisading histiocytic rim, special stains for organisms and clinical history is needed to support cat scratch disease.

ddx.vs: Caseous necrosis is more homogeneous without neutrophilic debris, and acid-fast stains or cultures identify mycobacteria.
Ghost outlines of large atypical cells and viable lymphoma at the periphery, confirmed by IHC, favor necrotic lymphoma.
Kikuchi shows karyorrhectic necrosis with abundant crescentic histiocytes and no neutrophils.

62459.recognize_zh: gate 在 CD3 T 細胞的 CD4 對 SSC 流式圖：CD4 gate 佔 CD3 細胞 99.76%，幾乎所有 T 細胞都是 CD4 陽性，但大部分 CD4 表現偏弱（藍色），只有 7.06% 位於正常 CD4 亮度的 gate A（綠色），顯示 CD4 dim 的異常 T 細胞大量擴增。
features: Dot plot of side scatter (SS INT) versus CD4-FITC gated on CD3-positive T cells
CD4 gate contains 99.76% of CD3 T cells (56.89% of total), indicating near-absent CD8 T cells
Most CD4 T cells (blue) show dim, broadly spread CD4 intensity below the normal range
Gate A (green) at normal CD4 intensity contains only 7.06% of gated T cells (residual normal CD4 T cells)
Low side scatter throughout; non-morphologic figure
62459.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of side scatter versus CD4 on CD3-gated T cells shows that 99.76% of T cells fall within the CD4 gate, indicating a marked CD4 predominance with virtually absent CD8 T cells. Most of these cells express CD4 at dim intensity, with only 7.06% of T cells located in gate A at normal CD4 brightness. The expanded CD4-dim population correlates with the CD7-negative and CD26-negative population in companion plots. Findings are consistent with a markedly elevated CD4:CD8 ratio and an aberrant CD4-dim T-cell population, supporting peripheral blood involvement by Sezary cells.

ddx.vs: Normal T cells show about 60-70% CD4 and 30-40% CD8 with uniform bright CD4, unlike the near-exclusive CD4-dim population here.
Monocytes are CD4 dim but CD3 negative with higher side scatter, so they would be excluded by the CD3 gate.
ATLL also shows a CD4-predominant aberrant T-cell population but is CD25 bright and HTLV-1 positive.

62395.recognize_zh: 六格組圖中，骨髓抹片與切片的巨噬細胞內塞滿大量 2–4 µm 的小型卵圓酵母菌，外圍有透明暈；PAS 染成洋紅色、GMS 染成黑色的細胞內小酵母，是組織胞漿菌症（histoplasmosis）的特徵，周邊血則見嗜中性球毒性變化。
features: Panel A (PB): neutrophil with toxic changes (vacuolation) among normocytic red cells
Panel B (BM aspirate): macrophages containing numerous small intracellular oval yeasts with clear halos
Panels C-D (H&E): histiocytes distended by clusters of 2-4 micron yeasts with pericellular clearing
Panel E (PAS): magenta-staining small yeasts within histiocytes
Panel F (GMS): black-staining uniform small yeasts, some with narrow-based budding
Background marrow with mixed hematopoietic and inflammatory cells, no well-formed granulomas visible
62395.describe_en: Composite figure shows a peripheral blood smear with a neutrophil exhibiting toxic vacuolation (A). The bone marrow aspirate contains macrophages filled with numerous small, uniform intracellular yeast forms with surrounding clear halos (B). Corresponding H&E sections show histiocytes distended by clusters of 2-4 micron yeasts (C, D), which are highlighted by PAS (E) and Gomori methenamine silver (F) stains, with occasional narrow-based budding. Well-formed granulomas are not evident in these panels. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis involving the bone marrow, supported by positive urine and serum Histoplasma antigen.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a rod-shaped kinetoplast and are PAS- and GMS-negative, unlike Histoplasma yeasts.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are often sausage-shaped rather than budding.
C. glabrata yeasts are slightly larger, less uniformly intracellular, and grow readily on routine culture.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are GMS-negative, and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular cup-shaped forms rather than intra-histiocytic budding yeasts.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis in bone marrow — macrophages packed with 2–4 µm intracellular yeasts, PAS and GMS positive
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨噬細胞內帶透明暈的小酵母，問 PAS/GMS 結果如何區分病原：Histoplasma 為 PAS+、GMS+，Leishmania 為陰性且有 kinetoplast。
快速診斷：urine/serum Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高；培養需數週，骨髓培養與切片可幫助播散型診斷。
播散型多見於免疫低下（HIV、器官移植、TNF inhibitor）；可合併 hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis（HLH）與全血球減少。
治療：中重度播散型先用 liposomal amphotericin B，穩定後改 itraconazole 口服維持。
東南亞與中國南方需與 Talaromyces marneffei 鑑別：後者以分裂（septum）增殖而非出芽。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 Leishmania amastigotes：兩者皆在巨噬細胞內、大小相近，但 Leishmania 有棒狀 kinetoplast 且 PAS/GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 有透明暈、窄基出芽且 GMS 染黑。

quiz.q: 圖 F 中巨噬細胞內染成黑色的小型酵母是何病原？其診斷上最常用的非侵入性檢驗為何？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum；尿液/血清 Histoplasma antigen

62203.recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎全是小至中型的淋巴球，圓核、染色質粗塊、細胞質呈窄邊淡藍，部分細胞較大、核染色質較細並可見小核仁（前淋巴球），下方有一個破碎的塗抹細胞，符合 CLL 伴前淋巴球。
features: Monotonous population of small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Scant rim of pale-blue cytoplasm in most cells
Subset of larger cells with less condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli (prolymphocytes)
Smudge (basket) cell at the bottom and a ruptured cell at the lower right
Platelet clumps scattered in the background
62203.describe_en: The smear shows a monotonous population of small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and scant pale-blue cytoplasm. A proportion of larger cells shows less condensed chromatin and small nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes, and smudge cells are present. Scattered platelet clumps are noted. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma shows more irregular nuclei and a CD5+/CD23-negative, cyclin D1-positive phenotype, unlike CD23-positive CLL.
B-PLL is dominated (>55%) by medium cells with a single prominent nucleolus and is CD23-negative and FMC7/CD20-bright, whereas here small clumped-chromatin cells predominate.
Splenic marginal zone lymphoma cells often have polar villous projections and are usually CD5- and CD23-negative.

62139.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見一團緊密黏聚（cohesive）的中型異常細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而淡藍，與周圍散在造血細胞不同，提示非造血性轉移腫瘤（此例為肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Cohesive cluster of medium-sized malignant cells with nuclear molding
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, with a few small vacuoles
Separate small clusters of similar atypical cells at left
Hemodilute background; red cells show refractile drying artifact
62139.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background in which a cohesive cluster of medium-sized atypical cells is present, with additional small groups of similar cells nearby. The cells have round nuclei with finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles. The dot-like red cell inclusions are consistent with drying artifact. The cohesive clustering favors a non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor; in this clinical context the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, to be confirmed by biopsy with myogenin/desmin immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are dispersed as single cells without cohesive clusters and express TdT/CD34/CD19, whereas rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin and myogenin positive.
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive, lacking myogenic markers.
Ewing sarcoma cells often have PAS-positive glycogen vacuoles and strong membranous CD99 with NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement, rather than PAX3/7::FOXO1 fusions.
Burkitt cells are discohesive with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and express CD20/CD10 with MYC rearrangement.

62075.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一團緊密黏合、互相擠壓的大型細胞，核圓且有細顆粒染色質與小核仁，細胞質深藍並含多個小空泡，與周圍分散的血球明顯不同，提示轉移性腫瘤細胞群。
features: Tight cohesive cluster of large cells distinct from surrounding dispersed hematopoietic elements
High N:C ratio with round nuclei showing nuclear crowding and molding
Finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small clear vacuoles
Background shows mainly smeared red cells and few nucleated cells; overall marrow cellularity cannot be judged from this single field
62075.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a tight, cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large cells that stands out from the dispersed background elements. The cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round crowded nuclei with focal molding, finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small vacuoles. The background contains mostly red cells with few hematopoietic cells, although overall cellularity should be assessed on the biopsy. Findings are consistent with a metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor cell cluster; the primary site requires correlation with the core biopsy and immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are discohesive single cells rather than a molded cohesive cluster, and are CD20/CD10-positive.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale cytoplasmic hof away from the nucleus and lie in loose groups rather than crowded molded clusters with vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Clumped acute leukemia blasts or plasma cells
ddx.vs: Aggregated blasts or plasma cells lack true cohesion and nuclear molding, and are identified by flow cytometry markers (CD45, CD34, CD138) rather than keratin or neuroendocrine markers.

62011.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞偏多，除了成群的紅血球系前驅細胞外，可見體積小、核分葉不良的巨核細胞（hypolobated micromegakaryocyte，左下方）；小而少分葉的巨核細胞加上三系混雜，是 MDS 巨核細胞發育不良的切片線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces
Small megakaryocytes with hypolobated or monolobated round nuclei
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Admixed maturing granulocytes
No sheets of blasts; interstitial hemorrhage present
62011.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes include small forms with hypolobated, round nuclei, suggestive of dysmegakaryopoiesis. Erythroid precursors form clusters and granulocytic maturation is present. No sheets of blasts are identified. The findings are compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Del(5q) shows numerous non-lobated/hypolobated megakaryocytes typically of normal to large size and requires cytogenetic confirmation; ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation favor MDS-RS.
MDS/MPN-RS-T has large, hyperlobated MPN-like megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis rather than small hypolobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobated and well dispersed without micromegakaryocytes.

61947.recognize_zh: CD5染色下，濾泡間區有大量強膜狀陽性的T細胞，中央一個圓形區域（殘存濾泡）染色較淡、只散在少數陽性T細胞，說明結構仍保留、T細胞在濾泡間擴張，符合反應性變化。
features: Numerous CD5-positive small T cells with strong membranous staining in the interfollicular zone
Central rounded area with weak background staining and only scattered positive T cells, consistent with a residual follicle
Preserved compartmentalization of T-cell zones and B-cell follicle
No sheets of CD5-positive large atypical cells
61947.describe_en: Low-to-medium power CD5 immunostain highlights abundant T cells with strong membranous staining in expanded interfollicular zones. A rounded follicle-like area in the center contains only scattered CD5-positive T cells within a weakly stained B-cell compartment. The preserved follicular/interfollicular compartmentalization and absence of aberrant CD5 loss favor a reactive T-cell expansion, as seen in EBV reactivation.

ddx.vs: In these CD5+ B-cell neoplasms the positive cells co-express CD20 and form nodules or diffuse sheets (with cyclin D1 or LEF1), rather than being T cells in the interfollicular zone.
PTCL often shows aberrant loss of CD5 or CD7 in atypical T cells, whereas here CD5 is retained in a reactive-appearing T-cell population.
AITL effaces follicles and shows TFH marker expression with expanded FDC meshworks, whereas a residual follicle is preserved here.

61819.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆嗜中性球核分成兩大葉，葉間有兩個小核碎片（nuclear projections），細胞質顆粒偏少，屬於核分葉異常的發育不良嗜中性球；背景紅血球有輕度大小不一與橢圓形紅血球。
features: Neutrophil with two main nuclear lobes and small detached nuclear fragments between them
Coarsely clumped nuclear chromatin
Pale cytoplasm with reduced, sparse granulation
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and scattered ovalocytes
Platelets not conspicuous in this field
61819.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation, comprising two main lobes with small detached nuclear fragments between them, coarse chromatin and reduced cytoplasmic granulation. Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with scattered ovalocytes, and platelets are inconspicuous in this field. Dysplasia should be confirmed by review of multiple neutrophils. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Apoptotic neutrophils show dense, round, pyknotic nuclear fragments with hypereosinophilic shrunken cytoplasm rather than intact lobes with normal-sized cell.
Megaloblastic neutrophils have six or more connected lobes and are accompanied by oval macrocytes.
Congenital bilobed neutrophils are normally granulated and uniform, without detached nuclear fragments.

61755.recognize_zh: 高倍脾臟 H&E 中，紅髓被中到大型淋巴樣細胞浸潤，核卵圓、染色質泡狀、多有小而清楚的核仁，細胞質中量淡嗜雙性，夾雜紅血球與含鐵血黃素；細胞比典型脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤偏大，需排除大細胞轉化。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of medium to large lymphoid cells with oval to round vesicular nuclei
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells, with occasional binucleate or irregular nuclei
Moderate amounts of pale amphophilic cytoplasm with fairly distinct cell borders
Cells permeate red pulp with interspersed red blood cells and elongated sinus-lining/stromal cells
Scattered brown hemosiderin granules; occasional small lymphocytes and a few mitotic-appearing figures
61755.describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows red pulp diffusely infiltrated by medium to large lymphoid cells with oval vesicular nuclei, small distinct nucleoli and moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm, admixed with red blood cells, sinus-lining cells and scattered hemosiderin. The cells in this field are larger than the typical small-to-medium marginal zone cells of splenic marginal zone lymphoma. No overt necrosis is seen. The appearance is compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma involving red pulp, but the proportion of large cells raises the possibility of large-cell transformation, which should be evaluated with Ki-67 and review of sheets of large cells across the specimen.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (including transformation of SMZL)
ddx.vs: Defined by confluent sheets of large cells with high Ki-67, whereas SMZL is dominated by small to medium cells with only scattered large cells.
Cells have bland bean-shaped nuclei without nucleoli and abundant clear cytoplasm, with CD103, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positivity.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic or blastoid mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Shows cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity with CD5 expression and CCND1 rearrangement.
Medium-sized cells fill red pulp sinusoids with a CD3+ CD5- gamma-delta T-cell phenotype and isochromosome 7q.

61691.recognize_zh: 這顆細胞大小約與嗜中性球相當，整個細胞質與核上佈滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，顆粒大小一致並蓋住核的輪廓，核本身呈淡紫色、分葉不清，這就是嗜鹼性球（basophil）的典型樣貌。
features: Cell approximately 12 um, similar in size to a neutrophil
Numerous coarse, round, deep purple-black granules distributed over both cytoplasm and nucleus
Nucleus pale violet and partly obscured by granules; lobation not clearly discernible
Scant pale background cytoplasm visible between granules
Background normocytic red cells and a small platelet clump; no other leukocytes in field
61691.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocyte of neutrophil size among normocytic red cells. The cell contains abundant coarse, deep purple-black granules that overlie the nucleus and obscure its lobation. No dysplastic features such as hypogranularity or vacuolation are evident in this cell. Findings are consistent with a normal mature basophil.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round, central, non-lobated nucleus and granules confined to the cytoplasm that do not overlie the nucleus, and they are rarely seen in blood.
Eosinophils have larger, uniform orange-pink refractile granules and a clearly visible bilobed nucleus that is not obscured.
Toxic granules are fine to moderately coarse, dark but smaller and scattered in pink cytoplasm, with a clearly segmented nucleus visible beneath.
Promyelocytes are larger with a round nucleus, visible chromatin detail or nucleoli, a perinuclear hof and red-purple azurophilic granules.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature basophil — neutrophil-sized granulocyte with coarse purple-black granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：單顆細胞問名稱，關鍵是深紫黑色粗顆粒同時蓋在胞質與核上、看不清分葉；正常周邊血嗜鹼性球比例通常 <1–2%。
顆粒含 histamine 與 heparin，為水溶性，染色不佳時可溶出而留下空泡；toluidine blue 呈 metachromasia。
Flow/IHC：嗜鹼性球 CD123+、CD203c+、HLA-DR−、CD117−；肥大細胞 CD117+、tryptase+，這是區分兩者的考點。
持續嗜鹼性球增多是 CML 等 MPN 的線索；ICC 2022 仍保留 CML accelerated phase，血中嗜鹼性球 ≥20% 為其條件之一，WHO 5th 則已取消 AP。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為肥大細胞或嗜伊紅球：肥大細胞為組織細胞、較大、核圓居中未被完全遮蓋；嗜伊紅球顆粒橘紅發亮且不覆蓋雙葉核；毒性顆粒嗜中性球顆粒細小、核分葉清楚。

quiz.q: 這顆顆粒深紫黑、覆蓋整個核的細胞是什麼？它與肥大細胞在 flow 上最常用哪個標記區分？
quiz.a: Basophil；CD117（肥大細胞陽性、嗜鹼性球陰性），嗜鹼性球則 CD123+/CD203c+。

61627.recognize_zh: 中央一個大型組織球，細胞質充滿泡沫狀空泡，並吞噬數個小的深染核狀物（噬血現象），右側及上方另有細胞質偏藍的非典型大細胞；血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（尤其亞洲型）常合併噬血症候群。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant foamy, coarsely vacuolated cytoplasm
Engulfed small dense nuclear bodies and cellular debris within the histiocyte (hemophagocytosis)
Adjacent large atypical cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Background erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytes
61627.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant foamy vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed small nucleated cells and nuclear debris, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Nearby are large atypical mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, within a background of residual hematopoietic cells. Hemophagocytosis is a nonspecific finding but is a recognized association of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, particularly the hemophagocytic syndrome-associated variant. Findings are suggestive of lymphoma-associated hemophagocytosis in the setting of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphology of the hemophagocytic histiocyte is identical, so exclusion of lymphoma requires a biopsy with CD20 staining to look for intrasinusoidal large B cells.
Neoplastic cells are CD3/CD56 and EBER positive rather than CD20/PAX5 positive large B cells.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without engulfed hematopoietic cells.

61563.recognize_zh: 這顆中性球細胞質幾乎沒有顆粒、呈淡灰粉色（hypogranular），核分葉異常且染色質粗塊狀凝集，是典型的顆粒球系發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）；在 GATA2 胚系突變病人提示 MDS。
features: Single neutrophil of normal size
Markedly hypogranular, pale pink-gray cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Abnormal nuclear segmentation: two to three irregular lobes with a poorly formed configuration
Coarse, clumped nuclear chromatin
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis (occasional teardrop and elliptocytes); platelets present
61563.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with markedly hypogranular, pale cytoplasm and an abnormally segmented nucleus composed of irregular lobes with coarse, clumped chromatin. Background red cells show mild poikilocytosis including occasional teardrop cells and elliptocytes, and platelets are present. These are dysplastic granulocytic features; in a patient with a germline GATA2 mutation, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with germline GATA2 predisposition. Assessment of dysplasia requires ≥10% of neutrophils to be affected and correlation with marrow morphology and cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët change from drugs (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus) or HIV
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; drug/infection history and lack of multilineage dysplasia, cytopenias or clonal cytogenetics favor a reactive cause.
Affects nearly all neutrophils with bilobed/round nuclei and normal granulation, without cytopenias.
Artifactual hypogranularity affects all cells uniformly, whereas true dysplasia is heterogeneous and accompanied by nuclear hyposegmentation.
Also shows dysgranulopoiesis but requires persistent absolute monocytosis ≥0.5 × 10^9/L with ≥10% monocytes.

exam.answer_en: Dysgranulopoiesis in MDS with germline GATA2 mutation — hypogranular neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation and clumped chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：指著這顆中性球問「有哪些發育不良特徵」：hypogranulation 與異常分葉/pseudo-Pelger-Huët；形態上要求 ≥10% 中性球有發育不良才算該系 dysplasia。
GATA2 deficiency 臨床線索：MonoMAC（單核球、B 與 NK 細胞缺乏）、非結核分枝桿菌感染、HPV 疣、肺泡蛋白沉積症、淋巴水腫（Emberger syndrome）。
GATA2 相關 MDS 常為低細胞性骨髓，伴巨核細胞發育不良；常見 monosomy 7 或 trisomy 8，並可帶 ASXL1 次發突變。
年輕 MDS 或家族史陽性要做胚系檢測；親屬作為造血幹細胞捐贈者前需排除同一胚系突變。WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 皆列為胚系易感性骨髓腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 EDTA 久置或藥物（如 mycophenolate）引起的假性變化、或先天性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 當成 MDS 發育不良；先天型顆粒正常、染色質成熟且見於家族。

quiz.q: 這顆中性球有哪兩項發育不良特徵？GATA2 deficiency 常伴隨哪一種血球的明顯缺乏？
quiz.a: Hypogranulation 與異常核分葉；單核球（monocytopenia，另有 B/NK 細胞缺乏）

61499.recognize_zh: H&E 可見瀰漫成片、細胞較鬆散的大型異型細胞，核大、不規則且深染；免疫染色 CD20 呈強烈細胞膜陽性、BCL6 瀰漫核陽性，CD3 僅標出散在的小型反應性 T 細胞，符合肝臟大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: H&E: diffuse sheets of large, somewhat discohesive atypical cells with enlarged irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered apoptotic/crushed cells and thin fibrous strands; no residual hepatic architecture evident in this panel
CD20: strong diffuse membranous staining of the neoplastic cells
BCL6: strong nuclear positivity in the vast majority of tumor cells
CD3: negative in tumor cells, highlighting only scattered small background T cells
61499.describe_en: This four-panel figure from a liver needle core biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of large, discohesive atypical lymphoid cells with enlarged, irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei. Immunohistochemistry shows the neoplastic cells are strongly positive for CD20 (membranous) and BCL6 (nuclear), while CD3 stains only scattered small reactive T cells. Per the provided workup, the cells are also BCL2+, MUM1+, CD10-, CD30- and keratin-negative with a Ki-67 index above 95%. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma involving the liver (DLBCL, non-germinal center phenotype by Hans algorithm); FISH for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements is required to exclude high-grade B-cell lymphoma with rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive and keratin (AE1/AE3, CAM5.2) positive and CD20 negative, whereas this tumor is CD20+ and keratin-negative.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology and phenotype can be identical; FISH demonstrating concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements is required for that diagnosis.
ALCL is CD30 strongly positive with T-cell or null phenotype and CD20 negative, unlike this CD20+, CD30- tumor.
HSTCL shows sinusoidal infiltration by medium-sized CD3+ T cells, whereas the tumor cells here are CD3 negative and form sheets.

61435.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內可見大小不一的圓形透明空泡（脂質），周圍聚集泡沫狀組織球並混有小淋巴球，形成脂質肉芽腫（lipogranuloma）。
features: Clusters of histiocytes with foamy, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Variably sized round, empty (lipid) vacuoles, some large and extracellular, surrounded by histiocytes
Histiocytes with bland oval nuclei; no significant atypia
Admixed small mature lymphocytes and a fibrous septum with vessels
No necrosis, well-formed epithelioid granulomas or atypical cell population evident
61435.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows aggregates of histiocytes with foamy, microvesicular cytoplasm associated with variably sized round lipid vacuoles, admixed with small mature lymphocytes. The histiocytes have bland nuclei, and there is no necrosis or cytologic atypia. No metastatic carcinoma is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with lipogranulomas, in keeping with a reactive change after prior surgery (lumpectomy).

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells have atypical, eccentric nuclei with intracytoplasmic mucin and are keratin-positive, whereas foamy histiocytes are CD68/CD163-positive with bland nuclei.
Silicone produces similar vacuoles but often with refractile non-birefringent material and a history of implant, rather than post-lumpectomy fat necrosis.
Whipple histiocytes contain PAS-positive, diastase-resistant granular material and are less associated with large empty lipid vacuoles.
Lymphangiographic contrast produces large sinusoidal vacuoles with multinucleated giant cells in a patient with prior lymphangiography.

61371.recognize_zh: 血片中有兩顆漿細胞，核偏心、染色質粗塊，細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區；背景紅血球明顯堆疊成錢串狀（rouleaux），提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白，指向漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Two circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a distinct perinuclear hof (Golgi zone)
Marked rouleaux formation: erythrocytes stacked in short linear aggregates throughout the thin area
Occasional platelets; partially visible granulocyte at bottom edge
61371.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked rouleaux formation with red cells stacked in linear aggregates throughout the monolayer area. Two circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs are present. Findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm with an increased paraprotein; the absolute circulating plasma cell count (and percentage of leukocytes) should be quantified to evaluate for plasma cell leukemia, with serum protein electrophoresis/immunofixation and marrow examination.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are polytypic and usually unaccompanied by marked rouleaux, and a mixed spectrum of reactive lymphocytes is often present.
IgM paraprotein also causes rouleaux, but circulating cells are predominantly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes rather than mature plasma cells.
Artifactual stacking occurs only in thick areas and disperses in the monolayer, whereas true rouleaux persists in the thin feathered edge as here.
Agglutinated red cells form irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than orderly coin-stack chains.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm with circulating plasma cells — marked rouleaux and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof
pearls_zh: 考法：考官可能先問背景紅血球排列（rouleaux），再指漿細胞問「代表什麼？下一步？」答：單株免疫球蛋白升高；需計算循環漿細胞以排除 plasma cell leukemia。
Plasma cell leukemia：依 IMWG/WHO 5th，周邊血循環漿細胞 ≥5%（白血球分類）即定義 PCL，預後差。
Rouleaux 機轉：血漿蛋白（免疫球蛋白、纖維蛋白原）中和紅血球表面負電荷；相關檢查為 SPEP、immunofixation、serum free light chain，ESR 亦會升高。
漿細胞表型：CD138+、CD38+，腫瘤性者常 CD19−、CD45−/dim、CD56+，並有 κ 或 λ 輕鏈限制。
exam.pitfall_zh: Rouleaux 易與冷凝集素造成的紅血球凝集或厚片假影混淆；rouleaux 為整齊錢串狀排列並在薄區仍存在，凝集則為不規則立體團塊。

quiz.q: 圖中背景紅血球的排列稱為什麼？周邊血漿細胞達多少比例即定義 plasma cell leukemia（WHO 5th）？
quiz.a: Rouleaux formation；循環漿細胞 ≥5%

61307.recognize_zh: 抹片薄區中有三個大型母細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻，細胞質中等至豐富、呈灰藍色且無顆粒，符合單核母細胞（monoblast）的外觀；配合已知 AML-M5 病史，提示復發。
features: Three large blasts with round to oval nuclei
Fine, lacy chromatin; nucleoli faint in this image
Moderate to abundant grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic vacuoles identified
Background red cells with occasional crenated forms and scattered platelets
61307.describe_en: Thin area of the marrow smear shows three large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed lacy chromatin, and a moderate to abundant rim of grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified. Red cells show occasional crenated forms, and platelets are present. In a patient with known acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia, the morphology is consistent with relapsed disease; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b) are recommended to confirm monocytic lineage.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and higher N:C ratio and are negative for nonspecific esterase and monocytic markers.
Mature monocytes have folded nuclei with condensed chromatin and vacuolated cytoplasm rather than round nuclei with fine blastic chromatin.
Regenerating marrow shows a maturing spectrum of precursors and hematogones without a predominant monoblast population.

61243.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中的血小板呈淡灰藍色、幾乎看不到紫色 α 顆粒，部分體積偏大，外觀像「空殼」或幽靈樣，這種灰色無顆粒血小板是灰色血小板症候群（gray platelet syndrome）的線索。
features: Platelets are pale gray-blue and agranular, lacking the normal purple azurophilic (alpha) granules
Platelets vary in size, several enlarged relative to normal, with irregular 'ghost-like' outlines
Platelets appear decreased in number in this field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with scattered refractile drying artifact and occasional stomatocyte-like central pallor
No leukocytes present in this field for assessment
61243.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows platelets that are pale gray-blue, agranular and ghost-like, with several larger than normal platelets and an apparently reduced platelet number in this field. Red cells are mostly unremarkable apart from refractile drying artifact. No platelet clumps or satellitism are seen. Findings are consistent with alpha-granule-deficient (gray) platelets as seen in gray platelet syndrome; artifactual degranulation from EDTA storage or activation should be excluded, and electron microscopy and NBEAL2 testing confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Platelets are giant but retain normal purple granulation, with absent ristocetin agglutination.
Giant platelets have normal granules and neutrophils show Döhle-like inclusions (MYH9 aggregates).

ddx.dx: In vitro degranulation artifact or myelodysplastic hypogranular platelets
ddx.vs: Artifactual or MDS-related agranular platelets are accompanied by other dysplastic changes or preparation delay, and alpha-granules are present on EM.

exam.answer_en: Gray platelet syndrome — large, pale gray-blue agranular (alpha-granule-deficient) ghost-like platelets with thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指淡灰藍、無紫色顆粒的「幽靈樣」血小板，問缺少的是哪種顆粒 → α-granules；灰色血小板症候群是 α-storage pool deficiency。
遺傳：典型為體染色體隱性 NBEAL2 突變；GFI1B 突變（體染色體顯性）也可造成類似灰色血小板表型。
臨床特徵：輕至中度出血、macrothrombocytopenia、進行性骨髓纖維化與脾腫大，血清 vitamin B12 常升高；骨髓 megakaryocyte 可見 emperipolesis。
確診：電子顯微鏡顯示 α-granules 缺乏；α-granule 蛋白（如 P-selectin 表現、PF4）減少，dense granules 則正常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 EDTA 久置或活化造成的體外去顆粒，或 MDS 的低顆粒血小板；前者檢體延遲、後者伴其他系列發育不良，且兩者 EM 仍有 α-granules，需以新鮮抹片與 EM 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中淡灰色無顆粒的血小板缺乏哪一種顆粒？最常見的致病基因為何？
quiz.a: α-granules；NBEAL2

61179.recognize_zh: 五條血液抹片中，箭頭指的血小板體積接近甚至超過紅血球（巨大血小板），箭頭三角指的中性球細胞質邊緣有淡藍色、梭形的包涵體（Döhle-like body），兩者同時出現應想到 MYH9 相關疾病（MYH9-related disorder）。
features: Giant platelets (arrows) approaching or equal to the diameter of adjacent red cells, with granular centers and pale blue periphery
Neutrophils with discrete pale blue, spindle- to crescent-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions (arrowheads), Döhle-like bodies
Inclusions are sharply defined and located near the cell membrane, one per neutrophil in each panel
Neutrophil cytoplasm otherwise lacks toxic granulation or vacuolation
Normochromic normocytic red cells without schistocytes; reduced platelet density
61179.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows reduced numbers of platelets with many giant forms approaching or exceeding the size of red cells. Neutrophils contain distinct, pale blue, spindle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions near the cell membrane resembling Döhle bodies, without accompanying toxic granulation or cytoplasmic vacuolation. Red cells are unremarkable without schistocytes. In a patient with lifelong macrothrombocytopenia, findings are suggestive of an MYH9-related disorder; confirmation by immunofluorescence for NMMHC-IIA aggregates or MYH9 sequencing is recommended.

ddx.vs: True Döhle bodies are more diffuse and accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuolation, with normal-sized platelets.
Bernard-Soulier shows giant platelets but normal neutrophils without inclusions and absent ristocetin-induced agglutination.
ITP may have mildly enlarged platelets but not uniformly giant platelets and no neutrophil inclusions, with a normal prior count history.

ddx.dx: May-Hegglin anomaly vs other MYH9 phenotypes (Sebastian, Fechtner, Epstein)
ddx.vs: These are one allelic disease spectrum and cannot be separated by morphology; renal, hearing and ocular findings plus genotype define the phenotype.

exam.answer_en: MYH9-related disorder — giant platelets (arrows) with pale blue spindle-shaped Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils (arrowheads)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官分別指箭頭（巨大血小板）與三角箭頭（中性球淡藍梭形包涵體），問兩者組合的診斷 → MYH9-related disorder（包含 May-Hegglin anomaly 等舊名）。
機轉：MYH9 編碼 non-muscle myosin heavy chain IIA（NMMHC-IIA），體染色體顯性；Döhle-like body 是 NMMHC-IIA 異常聚集，與感染時由粗糙內質網構成的真正 Döhle body 不同。
確診：中性球 NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence 顯示異常聚集，或 MYH9 基因檢測；包涵體在 Wright 染色有時不明顯，免疫螢光較敏感。
器官表現需追蹤：感音性聽力喪失、腎病變（蛋白尿、進行性腎衰竭）、早發白內障、肝酵素上升；避免因誤診 ITP 而做脾切除或長期類固醇。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把 Döhle-like inclusion 當成感染的 toxic Döhle body：反應性 Döhle body 較模糊，伴 toxic granulation 與空泡且血小板大小正常；MYH9 包涵體邊界清楚、無中毒性變化並合併巨大血小板。

quiz.q: 三角箭頭所指中性球內的淡藍包涵體由何種蛋白聚集而成？對應的致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Non-muscle myosin heavy chain IIA（NMMHC-IIA）；MYH9

61115.recognize_zh: 骨盆 X 光顯示骨質粗糙增厚與硬化（Paget 病樣），骨髓抹片見增多的漿細胞；骨切片可見大量多核蝕骨細胞位於吸收凹陷（Howship lacunae，箭頭）、骨小樑呈不規則鑲嵌狀黏合線（mosaic pattern）與骨髓纖維化，兩個疾病同時存在。
features: Radiograph (A): coarse trabecular thickening and sclerosis of the pelvis and sacrum, consistent with Paget disease of bone
Aspirate (B): increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, some binucleated/larger forms
Biopsy (C, E): numerous large multinucleated osteoclasts, some in Howship lacunae (arrow in E), with fibrovascular marrow stroma
Bone (F): irregular trabeculae with haphazard cement lines forming a mosaic pattern (arrow)
Panel D: marrow fragment with low cellularity on a light stain; panel G: special stain highlighting fibrous stroma (green)
61115.describe_en: Composite figure. The pelvic radiograph shows coarse, thickened trabeculae and sclerosis typical of Paget disease of bone. The bone marrow aspirate demonstrates an increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, including larger atypical forms. The trephine biopsy shows increased osteoclastic activity with numerous multinucleated osteoclasts in resorption lacunae, fibrovascular replacement of the intertrabecular marrow, and bone with a mosaic cement line pattern, with fibrosis highlighted on a special stain. Findings are consistent with coexisting plasma cell myeloma and Paget disease of bone; the lytic and sclerotic changes of each must be distinguished radiologically and histologically.

ddx.vs: Hyperparathyroidism shows dissecting (tunneling) resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis but lacks a mosaic cement line pattern, with elevated PTH and calcium.
POEMS lesions are sclerotic with lambda-restricted plasma cells rimming thickened trabeculae but lack Pagetoid osteoclast hyperactivity and mosaic bone.
Osteoblastic metastases show cohesive keratin/PSA-positive tumor cells in fibrotic marrow rather than a mosaic pattern.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, perivascular and polytypic, whereas myeloma shows monotypic light chains and clonal markers.

61051.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見大卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），骨髓抹片出現巨大後髓細胞（giant metamyelocyte）、分葉過多嗜中性球與核質發育不同步的巨母紅血球，三系皆有異常造血，符合 B12 代謝障礙（transcobalamin II 缺乏）造成的巨母細胞變化。
features: Peripheral blood with anisocytosis and scattered oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes)
Aspirate panels show giant metamyelocytes/bands and hypersegmented neutrophils
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open, sieve-like chromatin and relatively mature cytoplasm (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Dysplastic-appearing megakaryocytic/myeloid forms mimicking myelodysplasia
Markedly hypercellular marrow biopsy (H&E) with sheets of immature-appearing precursors
Immunostain (panel C) highlights only scattered positive cells, without increased positive blasts
61051.describe_en: Multipanel figure. The peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with oval macrocytes. The bone marrow biopsy is markedly hypercellular with a predominance of immature-appearing hematopoietic precursors, and an immunostain labels only scattered cells. Aspirate smears show megaloblastic erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and bands, and hypersegmented neutrophils, i.e., trilineage dyspoiesis. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis due to impaired cobalamin transport (transcobalamin II deficiency), which can mimic myelodysplastic syndrome or acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: MDS lacks giant metamyelocytes with uniformly megaloblastic open chromatin and does not reverse with cobalamin; serum/functional B12 studies (homocysteine, methylmalonic acid, TCII levels) and cytogenetics separate them.
Leukemia shows a true blast population by CD34/CD117 staining, whereas here the immunostain labels only scattered cells and the precursors mature into giant granulocytes.
Morphology is identical; transcobalamin II deficiency typically presents in infancy with normal serum B12 but low functional cobalamin, requiring biochemical/genetic testing.

60987.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被單一族群的中型母細胞樣細胞佔滿，核形不規則、凹陷或折疊，染色質細顆粒狀，細胞質少量灰藍色且無顆粒，部分細胞質邊緣有細小空泡，缺乏正常造血成分，結合免疫表型符合 BPDCN 骨髓浸潤。
features: Sheets of monotonous medium-sized blastoid cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
High N:C ratio with irregular, indented, folded or reniform nuclear contours
Finely granular to slightly condensed chromatin with occasional small indistinct nucleoli
Scant-to-moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, some with small peripheral vacuoles or pseudopod-like tails
Background of stripped pale blue cytoplasmic material; rare residual small lymphocytes; no Auer rods
60987.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of medium-sized blastoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, irregular indented to folded nuclei, finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant, pale gray-blue and agranular, with occasional small peripheral vacuoles; Auer rods are not seen and residual normal hematopoietic elements are scarce. These appearances are nonspecific blastic morphology, but in conjunction with a CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ immunophenotype they are consistent with bone marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Blasts have more abundant, often finely granular cytoplasm and are nonspecific esterase- and lysozyme-positive, whereas BPDCN cells are agranular and esterase-negative with TCF4/CD303 expression.
Morphologically similar, but lymphoblasts are TdT/CD34-positive with cCD3 or CD19/CD79a expression and lack bright CD123 with CD4/CD56.
Cells often show azurophilic granules, are CD56-positive but CD4/CD123-negative and EBV-positive.
Blasts express CD34/CD117/CD13/CD33 by flow and at least partial MPO, unlike BPDCN.

exam.answer_en: Bone marrow involvement by BPDCN — monotonous agranular blastoid cells with irregular nuclei and small peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這群無顆粒、核不規則的 blast 樣細胞，問細胞質邊緣的特徵 → 細小空泡沿細胞膜排列（似珍珠項鍊）與偽足狀尾巴，是 BPDCN 抹片的提示線索。
細胞化學：MPO 與 nonspecific esterase 皆陰性，可與 myeloid/monocytic 白血病區分；確診靠 flow 或 IHC（CD4、CD56、CD123、TCF4、TCL1、CD303）。
無 Auer rods；形態上為非特異的 blastic morphology，必須結合免疫表型，考試常以「無顆粒 blast + 皮膚病灶」組合出題。
骨髓侵犯提示全身性疾病，需完整分期（含腰椎穿刺評估 CNS），治療計畫與皮膚單獨病灶相同需系統性治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 acute monoblastic leukemia 或 ALL：monoblast 細胞質較多、常細顆粒且 NSE 陽性；lymphoblast 為 TdT/CD34 陽性並有 cCD3 或 CD19；BPDCN 則 NSE 與 MPO 皆陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中無顆粒 blast 樣細胞的細胞質邊緣有何特徵？其 MPO 與 nonspecific esterase 染色結果應為何？
quiz.a: 細胞膜下細小空泡（珍珠項鍊狀）與偽足；MPO 與 NSE 皆陰性（BPDCN）

60923.recognize_zh: 高倍下纖維化的膠原中可見沿纖維沉積的深藍黑色與金褐色鈣鐵結晶，形成彎曲斷裂、似菌絲的條狀物，旁邊是血管與紅血球，符合脾臟 Gamna-Gandy 小體的鐵鈣質沉著。
features: Dense hyalinized collagenous stroma
Dark blue-black linear encrustations along collagen and elastic fibers (calcium with iron)
Golden-brown refractile hemosiderin deposits and fragmented, rod-like mineralized fibers
Beaded, curved segments that can mimic fungal hyphae
Adjacent vessel with red cells and congested red pulp at the edge
60923.describe_en: High-power view of spleen shows dense hyalinized fibrous tissue in which collagen and elastic fibers are encrusted by dark blue-black mineral deposits and golden-brown hemosiderin, forming fragmented, curved, rod-like structures. An adjacent thin-walled vessel and congested red pulp are present. There is no inflammatory reaction or identifiable organism. Findings are consistent with the ferrocalcinotic fibers of a Gamna-Gandy body; iron and calcium stains (Prussian blue, von Kossa) and GMS can confirm and exclude fungal hyphae.

ddx.vs: Fungal hyphae are uniform, septate and branch at acute angles with GMS positivity, whereas these encrusted fibers are irregular, Prussian blue positive and lack true septation.

ddx.dx: Dystrophic calcification of old infarct or hematoma
ddx.vs: Dystrophic calcification forms granular or amorphous basophilic deposits without linear iron-encrusted fibers.
Foreign material is typically polarizable and associated with foreign-body giant cells, which are absent here.

exam.answer_en: Gamna-Gandy body (high power) — ferrocalcinotic encrustation of collagen/elastic fibers forming fragmented, hypha-like rods
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍下考官指彎曲斷裂、藍黑色的條狀物，問「是黴菌菌絲嗎」→ 不是，為鐵與鈣沉著包覆膠原與彈性纖維（ferrocalcinotic fibers），屬 Gamna-Gandy body。
要求的鑑別染色：GMS 或 PAS 排除真菌，Prussian blue 證實鐵，von Kossa 證實鈣。
Gamna-Gandy body 本質是局部出血機化後的鐵鈣沉著，常見於門脈高壓與 sickle cell disease，也可見於其他有陳舊出血的器官或腫瘤。
無發炎反應、無壞死或組織破壞是支持非感染性的重要線索。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為 Aspergillus：真菌菌絲寬度一致、有隔膜與 45 度銳角分枝並常伴發炎壞死、GMS 陽性；此處條狀物粗細不均、斷裂彎曲、帶金褐色鐵色素且無發炎反應。

quiz.q: 圖中纖維組織內彎曲斷裂、似菌絲的藍黑色條狀物是什麼？用哪種染色可排除真菌？
quiz.a: Gamna-Gandy body 的鐵鈣沉著纖維；GMS（或 PAS）染色陰性可排除真菌

60859.recognize_zh: 高倍可見小淋巴細胞與具較多淡染或空泡狀細胞質、核略不規則的邊緣區樣細胞及組織球混雜，另有少數漿細胞，缺乏成片大型芽細胞；這種多樣的細胞組成是皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤的典型背景。
features: Mixed population of small lymphocytes with dark round nuclei and medium-sized cells with oval to slightly irregular nuclei
Many cells with pale to clear, vacuolated cytoplasm (marginal zone/monocytoid B cells and histiocytes)
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, not forming sheets
Few plasma cells and epithelioid histiocytes admixed
Dermal collagen bundle at upper left
60859.describe_en: High-power view of the dermal infiltrate shows a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, medium-sized marginal zone-type cells with pale to vacuolated cytoplasm and slightly irregular nuclei, scattered histiocytes and a few plasma cells. Occasional larger cells with vesicular chromatin are present but do not form confluent sheets. Mitotic activity is not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with the cellular composition of primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma, to be confirmed with immunohistochemistry and light-chain studies.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, rather than scattered large cells in a small-cell background.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; immunostains show predominance of PD-1-positive CD4 T cells without monotypic plasma cells.
Reactive infiltrates can look identical at high power; distinction relies on architecture and light-chain restriction.

60795.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見體積巨大、多核或多葉核的間變性漿細胞，胞質豐富灰藍（A），插圖箭頭指出核內包涵體；切片中多個腫瘤細胞核內有淡染、圓形空泡狀的核內包涵體（Dutcher bodies，B 箭頭），符合帶 Dutcher 小體的間變型漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A: markedly enlarged, pleomorphic plasma cells with multilobated or multiple nuclei and abundant blue-gray cytoplasm
Coarse to open chromatin with visible nucleoli in anaplastic cells, admixed with more conventional plasma cells
Panel A inset: intranuclear inclusion (arrow) within a large neoplastic cell
Panel B: tissue section with multiple pale round intranuclear pseudoinclusions (Dutcher bodies, arrowheads), some cells containing several
Background of eosinophilic proteinaceous material and scattered tumor cells with prominent nucleoli
60795.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate (A) shows numerous atypical plasma cells, including markedly enlarged anaplastic forms with multilobated or multiple nuclei, open chromatin, nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm; the inset highlights an intranuclear inclusion. The corresponding tissue section (B) shows pleomorphic tumor cells containing multiple pale, rounded intranuclear inclusions (arrowheads) consistent with Dutcher bodies. Findings are consistent with the anaplastic variant of plasma cell myeloma with Dutcher bodies; CD138, MUM1 and light-chain restriction studies are needed to confirm plasma cell lineage in such bizarre cells.

ddx.vs: Bizarre multinucleated cells can mimic metastasis, but these lack cohesion and would be CD138/MUM1 positive with light-chain restriction and cytokeratin/SOX10 negative.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with granular pink cytoplasm and no perinuclear hof, and are CD61/CD42b positive.
Shows monomorphic immunoblastic cells, frequent EBER positivity and extramedullary presentation rather than giant multinucleated anaplastic plasma cells with Dutcher bodies.
Dutcher bodies are also common, but the infiltrate consists of small lymphocytes and mature plasmacytoid cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

60603.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片的大型組織球，胞質豐富、嗜伊紅且呈纖維狀／結晶狀紋理，細胞核被擠到一側；抹片中巨噬細胞塞滿結晶物質，旁邊有漿細胞，免疫染色顯示單一輕鏈（κ）限制，提示結晶儲積組織球增生症（crystal-storing histiocytosis）合併漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with interstitial sheets of large polygonal cells with abundant pink cytoplasm on low power
High power: histiocytes packed with eosinophilic fibrillary/crystalline cytoplasmic material, small eccentric nuclei
Aspirate smear: macrophage stuffed with numerous deeply stained rod-like/granular crystalline inclusions; nearby plasma cells
Plasma cell with basophilic cytoplasm containing coarse purple inclusions
Immunohistochemistry: brown cytoplasmic staining of scattered plasma cells for one light chain, with crystal-laden histiocytes negative in the paired light-chain stain
60603.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) is hypercellular with interstitial aggregates and sheets of large histiocytes whose abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm is expanded by fibrillary crystalline material. Aspirate smears show macrophages engorged with numerous crystalline inclusions and plasma cells, some containing coarse cytoplasmic inclusions. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates light-chain–restricted plasma cells (kappa) with a negative paired stain. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a kappa-restricted plasma cell neoplasm; heavy-chain (IgD) staining and serum studies support the specific isotype.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm without refractile crystals and are not accompanied by a light-chain–restricted plasma cell population.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes show striated cytoplasm that is AFB-positive, whereas CSH crystals are immunoglobulin and AFB-negative.
These are not in marrow and lack immunoglobulin crystals and clonal plasma cells; S100 or muscle markers are positive instead of CD68 with light chain.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with intracytoplasmic crystals (without histiocytosis)
ddx.vs: In myeloma crystals lie within plasma cells, whereas in CSH the crystals are predominantly in CD68-positive histiocytes.

60667.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大量成熟樣漿細胞：核圓而偏心、染色質呈車輪狀塊狀、細胞質豐富深藍並有核旁淡染區；流式顯示 CD38 強陽性、CD138 陽性且細胞質 κ 輕鏈單株限制，於心臟移植後 EBV 高病毒量背景下符合漿細胞樣 PTLD 白血病期。
features: Panel A: medium-sized plasma cells with round eccentric nuclei and coarsely clumped 'clock-face' chromatin
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear hof in several cells
No prominent nucleoli; cells appear mature rather than plasmablastic; one binucleate-appearing pair
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and some crenated forms
Panel B (flow): plasma cells (green) CD38 bright and CD138 positive, with monotypic cytoplasmic kappa and no cytoplasmic lambda
60667.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating plasma cells with round eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, on a background of red cell rouleaux. Flow cytometry identifies a CD38-bright, CD138-positive plasma cell population with monotypic cytoplasmic kappa light chain restriction. In the setting of a recent heart allograft, intensive immunosuppression and a high EBV viral load, findings are consistent with a monomorphic EBV-associated post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder with plasmacytic features in leukemic phase; morphology alone cannot separate this from primary plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinction rests on the post-transplant EBV-driven context (EBER positivity) and typically CD19-negative, CD56-variable myeloma immunophenotype.
Reactive circulating plasma cells are polytypic for kappa and lambda and usually few in number.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with surface light chain-positive CD20+ B cells and MYD88 L265P.
Plasmablasts are larger with dispersed chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and high Ki-67, unlike these mature-appearing plasma cells.

60731.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球之間可見細長、呈波浪彎曲的錐蟲鞭毛體（trypomastigote），具起伏膜、游離鞭毛與位於後端的小型動基體（kinetoplast），體長約 2–3 個紅血球直徑，符合非洲錐蟲病（Trypanosoma brucei）。
features: Extracellular slender, sinuous flagellated parasites approximately 2–3 red cell diameters long
Undulating membrane along the body with a free anterior flagellum
Central dark purple nucleus with a small, inconspicuous posterior kinetoplast
Parasites lie between red cells; no intraerythrocytic organisms
Background red cells unremarkable
60731.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows extracellular trypomastigotes with slender, wavy bodies, a prominent undulating membrane, a free anterior flagellum, a central nucleus and a small subterminal kinetoplast. No intracellular parasites are seen. In a traveler returning from sub-Saharan Africa, findings are consistent with human African trypanosomiasis (Trypanosoma brucei); species assignment (gambiense vs rhodesiense) depends on travel geography and molecular testing, and CSF examination is needed for staging.

ddx.vs: T. cruzi trypomastigotes are typically C- or U-shaped with a large, bulging terminal kinetoplast, whereas T. brucei has a small kinetoplast and slender wavy form.
T. rangeli is longer and thinner with a small subterminal kinetoplast and is nonpathogenic, found in Central/South America rather than Africa.
Microfilariae are much larger worms spanning many red cells, with a column of nuclei and no undulating membrane or flagellum.
Borrelia are thin helical spirochetes without a nucleus, kinetoplast or undulating membrane.

captions: Trypomastigote with undulating membrane and free flagellum
Second trypomastigote with slender wavy body and small kinetoplast

exam.answer_en: Human African trypanosomiasis — extracellular slender Trypanosoma brucei trypomastigotes with undulating membrane and small subterminal kinetoplast
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球間細長波浪狀、有 undulating membrane 與鞭毛的寄生蟲，問「這是什麼？如何分種？」→ trypomastigote，靠 kinetoplast 大小與位置。
T. brucei gambiense 分布於西/中非、病程慢性；T. b. rhodesiense 分布於東/南非、病程急性，旅客感染較常見；兩者形態無法區分，需旅遊地理與分子檢測。
傳播媒介為采采蠅（tsetse fly）；分期必須做腰椎穿刺看 CSF 白血球與寄生蟲，決定是否進入中樞神經期與用藥。
低寄生蟲量時可用 buffy coat 濃縮或厚片提高偵測率。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 T. cruzi 混淆：T. cruzi 常呈 C 形、kinetoplast 大且位於末端，來自中南美；T. brucei 細長、kinetoplast 小且 subterminal，來自非洲。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球間的寄生蟲是什麼期別？與 T. cruzi 鑑別時看哪個構造？
quiz.a: Trypomastigote（T. brucei）；kinetoplast（小、subterminal）

60539.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中可見多顆大型不典型淋巴樣細胞，細胞核不規則、有深凹陷或分葉（部分呈花瓣／苜蓿葉樣），細胞質深藍且部分含空泡；與旁邊的嗜中性球和小淋巴球相比明顯較大，形態多形，需以 T 細胞表型與 HTLV-1 證實 ATLL。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, markedly larger than an adjacent small lymphocyte and neutrophil
Pleomorphic nuclei: irregular, deeply indented, cleaved to lobulated (focally flower-like) contours
Moderately condensed chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several cells with prominent small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background marrow elements include a segmented neutrophil, a small lymphocyte, and red cells; hemodilute proteinaceous background
60539.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large, pleomorphic atypical lymphoid cells among residual neutrophils, a small lymphocyte, and red cells. The atypical cells have irregular, deeply indented to lobulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and a moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several containing discrete clear vacuoles. Classic well-formed flower cells are not prominent, and the vacuolated basophilic morphology overlaps with anaplastic large cell lymphoma and plasmablastic neoplasms. With a CD3+/CD4+ phenotype and loss of CD5, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a mature T-cell neoplasm, compatible with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma pending HTLV-1 serology.

ddx.vs: ALCL cells are uniformly strongly CD30+ with horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei and often ALK expression, whereas ATLL is CD25+ and HTLV-1 associated with variable CD30.
Plasmablasts have eccentric round nuclei with a hof and are CD138+/MUM1+ and CD3-negative.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with non-vacuolated scant cytoplasm and an erythroderma presentation, and are HTLV-1 negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have fine chromatin, folded nuclei, gray-blue cytoplasm and are nonspecific esterase and CD64/CD14 positive rather than CD3+.

60475.recognize_zh: 中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓形偏心、染色質中度凝集，淡藍灰色細胞質四周有細長毛狀突起，其中一條向下拖出長絲，是典型毛狀細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; no conspicuous nucleolus
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular circumferential hair-like projections, including a long thin cytoplasmic filament
Background red cells normochromic with a few irregular forms; occasional platelets
60475.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical lymphoid cell with a round eccentric nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, and pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular circumferential projections, including an elongated filamentous extension. Nucleoli are not prominent. The background red cells show no specific abnormality. Findings are consistent with a circulating hairy cell of hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short, often polar villi and more basophilic cytoplasm and are negative for CD103, CD25, and annexin A1.
HCL-v cells contain a prominent nucleolus and lack CD25 and annexin A1 expression.

ddx.dx: Smudge/preparation artifact of a normal lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Artifactual cytoplasmic tails are usually single and unilateral on crushed cells, whereas hairy cells show multiple fine projections around an intact cell and a characteristic immunophenotype.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — circulating hairy cell with circumferential projections including a long cytoplasmic filament
pearls_zh: 考法：指著細胞質拖出長絲的淋巴樣細胞，問此形態名稱與確認檢查；答 hairy cell，需 flow 或 BRAF V600E。
flow 表型：CD19/CD20+（強）、CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 皆陽性，CD5−、CD10 多陰性；CD200 強陽性。
分子：BRAF V600E 突變幾乎見於所有 classic HCL，可用 VE1 免疫染色或 PCR 檢測；HCL-variant（WHO 5th 改稱 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）無此突變。
HCL 經 cladribine 治療後追蹤 MRD 時，骨髓切片常用 CD20 搭配 BRAF V600E（VE1）或 annexin A1 判讀殘存細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單顆拖絲細胞可能是推片假影（淋巴球被拉扯），需找多顆周緣皆有突起的細胞；SMZL 的 villi 則偏極性分布。

quiz.q: 此淋巴樣細胞周緣的細長突起提示哪個疾病？flow 上哪個標記組合最具代表性？
quiz.a: Hairy cell leukemia；CD11c+、CD25+、CD103+、CD123+

60347.recognize_zh: 流式圖中 CD45 弱陽性、側向散射（SSC）偏高且分布寬的異常群，MPO 強陽性、TdT 陰性，CD33 均勻亮、CD13 不均、CD117 部分陽性，而 CD34 與 HLA-DR 皆陰性，是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的典型表型。
features: CD45 vs SSC: large CD45-dim population with intermediate-to-high, broad side scatter (gated 'Dim CD45+'), separate from CD45-bright lymphocytes
MPO strongly positive; TdT negative
CD33 bright and homogeneous with heterogeneous CD13 expression
CD117 partially positive; CD34 negative
HLA-DR negative; CD2 largely negative with a small dim tail
60347.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a predominant abnormal population with dim CD45 and increased, broad side scatter reflecting cytoplasmic granularity. The gated cells are strongly positive for MPO, brightly and homogeneously positive for CD33, heterogeneously positive for CD13 and partially positive for CD117, and are negative for TdT, CD34 and HLA-DR, with only a minor dim CD2-positive tail. This CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative, high side scatter myeloid phenotype with bright CD33 and heterogeneous CD13 is characteristic of acute promyelocytic leukemia. Urgent confirmation of PML-RARA by FISH or RT-PCR is recommended given the risk of coagulopathy.

ddx.vs: Normal maturation shows a continuous CD13/CD16/CD11b maturation pattern with CD13 bright-dim-bright and no expanded uniform CD33-bright population.
NPM1-mutated AML can be CD34-/HLA-DR- but often shows monocytic markers and lacks the high side scatter and heterogeneous CD13 pattern; PML-RARA is absent.
These blasts are usually CD34+ and/or HLA-DR+ with lower side scatter and show maturation to CD11b/CD15+ granulocytes.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia by flow — CD45-dim high-SSC MPO+ population, CD33 bright, CD13 heterogeneous, CD117 partial, CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative
pearls_zh: 判讀：先看 CD45/SSC 找出 CD45 dim、SSC 偏高（顆粒多）的族群，再看典型組合：CD34-、HLA-DR-、CD33 bright、CD13 heterogeneous、CD11b 陰性——看到就要喊 APL。
APL 是急症：flow 或形態一懷疑就立即給 ATRA，不等 PML::RARA FISH/RT-PCR 確認；同時監測並積極矯正 DIC（fibrinogen、血小板）。
Microgranular variant（M3v）常見 CD2 表現、SSC 較低、WBC 高，與 bcr3 短型轉錄本相關；本圖 CD2 僅小尾巴弱陽性。
低/中風險（WBC ≤10×10⁹/L）標準治療為 ATRA + arsenic trioxide；高 WBC 需加化療（如 anthracycline）；注意 differentiation syndrome 與 ATO 的 QTc 延長。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 NPM1-mutated AML 混淆（兩者皆可 CD34-/HLA-DR-），NPM1 AML 常有 monocytic 標記且缺乏高 SSC 與 CD13 不均分布；也易與正常前骨髓細胞混淆，後者有連續的 CD13/CD16/CD11b 成熟曲線。

quiz.q: 這組 flow 結果（CD34-、HLA-DR-、MPO+、SSC 高、CD33 bright）最可能的診斷為何？確認前應立即採取什麼處置？
quiz.a: APL（PML::RARA）；立即開始 ATRA 並處理 DIC，不必等分子確認。

60219.recognize_zh: 大多數紅血球比右下角小淋巴球的核還小，中央淡染區明顯擴大（低色素 hypochromia），並夾雜細長的鉛筆狀細胞（pencil cells）、淚滴形及不規則形紅血球，符合缺鐵性貧血的周邊血液抹片。
features: Red cells microcytic relative to the small lymphocyte nucleus (lower right)
Hypochromia with widened central pallor in many red cells
Moderate anisopoikilocytosis including elongated pencil cells, teardrop and irregular forms
Scattered normal-appearing platelets, not clearly increased
No target cell predominance, basophilic stippling or nucleated red cells in this field
60219.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are predominantly microcytic, as judged against the nucleus of a small lymphocyte, with increased central pallor indicating hypochromia. There is moderate anisopoikilocytosis with elongated pencil cells and occasional teardrop forms. Basophilic stippling and prominent target cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with moderate iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Red cells are microcytic but more uniform with target cells and basophilic stippling and a normal or high RBC count, with normal ferritin and abnormal HbA2 or globin gene studies.
Usually normocytic or mildly microcytic with little poikilocytosis, and ferritin is normal to increased.
Often shows a dimorphic red cell population with Pappenheimer bodies, and marrow iron stain reveals ring sideroblasts.

exam.answer_en: Iron deficiency anemia (moderate) — microcytic hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor and pencil cells
pearls_zh: 考法：用右下小淋巴球的核當尺，判斷紅血球為小球性；再指出中央淡染區擴大（hypochromia）與細長的 pencil cells。
實驗室：ferritin 低是最具診斷力的單一檢查（<30 ng/mL 支持缺鐵），但 ferritin 是 acute phase reactant，發炎時可假性正常；另見 RDW 升高、transferrin saturation 低、TIBC 高。
鑑別地中海貧血：缺鐵的 RBC count 低、RDW 高；thalassemia trait 的 RBC count 正常或偏高、細胞大小均一，Mentzer index（MCV/RBC）<13 傾向地中海貧血。
成人男性與停經女性缺鐵要找出血來源（上下消化道內視鏡），並考慮 H. pylori、celiac disease 等吸收不良原因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 thalassemia trait 混淆；地中海貧血紅血球大小較一致、target cells 與 basophilic stippling 較多、RBC count 正常或高，缺鐵則大小不一且有 pencil cells，靠 ferritin 與 HbA2/基因檢查區分。

quiz.q: 圖中細長如鉛筆的紅血球叫什麼？確認此抹片診斷最具價值的單一血清檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: Pencil cells（elliptocytes of iron deficiency）；serum ferritin。

60155.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的髓腔被淡粉紅纖維性基質取代，造血細胞沿纖維呈流線狀（streaming）排列，並有擴張的竇腔與成群、核深染的異型巨核細胞，符合真性紅血球增多症後的骨髓纖維化。
features: Intertrabecular marrow replaced by loose fibrotic stroma with streaming of hematopoietic cells
Dilated sinusoids containing red cells and cellular elements (intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis)
Clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with dark hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei
Residual patchy cellularity with fat and bony trabeculae with preserved lamellar architecture
No overt osteosclerosis in this field
60155.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows marrow spaces partly replaced by fibrotic stroma, with streaming of hematopoietic elements and dilated sinuses. Residual hematopoiesis includes clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei. Bony trabeculae are present without obvious osteosclerosis. Findings are consistent with a fibrotic-stage myeloproliferative neoplasm, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains are needed for grading.

ddx.vs: Histologically indistinguishable; the diagnosis of post-PV myelofibrosis requires documented prior polycythemia vera.
Fibrosis contains cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests rather than atypical megakaryocyte clusters.
Presents acutely with increased CD34-positive blasts and small dysplastic megakaryocytes, lacking a prior MPN history.

60091.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓顆粒（particle）幾乎全被大型脂肪空泡占據，中央只剩一塊深染的基質與少量細胞區，周圍抹片有核細胞極少；脂肪為主的空洞顆粒提示嚴重低細胞性骨髓，屬骨髓衰竭表現。
features: Low-power aspirate particle composed predominantly of large fat vacuoles
Small central dark-staining area of stroma with limited cellular elements
Very few nucleated hematopoietic cells in the surrounding smear
No clusters of blasts or abnormal cells identifiable at this power
Individual cell morphology not resolvable at this magnification
60091.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a particle composed predominantly of large fat vacuoles with only a small central dark-staining stromal and cellular area, and very few nucleated cells in the surrounding trails. No abnormal cellular aggregates are identified, although individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. The appearance indicates a markedly hypocellular marrow. In a patient with pancytopenia, findings are consistent with bone marrow failure, here in the setting of dyskeratosis congenita; core biopsy is required for accurate cellularity assessment.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; dyskeratosis congenita is distinguished by very short telomeres, mucocutaneous triad and germline telomere gene mutations.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or increased CD34+ blasts and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
A hemodilute sample lacks particles or has particles with normal cellularity, so correlation with core biopsy cellularity is required.

60027.recognize_zh: 周邊血中三顆緊貼的母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞核邊緣有淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核），細胞質淡藍且無顆粒；在白血球增多並以母細胞為主的背景下，提示 NPM1 突變 AML。
features: Three medium to large blasts clustered together
High N:C ratio with finely dispersed chromatin
Pale nuclear invaginations giving indented or cup-shaped contours
Scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic
60027.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of three medium to large blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, and scant agranular pale-blue cytoplasm. Several nuclei show a pale indentation producing a cup-like nuclear contour. Auer rods are not identified, and red cells are unremarkable. The field shows only blasts among the leukocytes present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with circulating blasts, and the cup-like nuclear morphology is suggestive of AML with mutated NPM1, pending molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei and often Auer rods, whereas these blasts have cup-shaped invaginations without Auer rods; PML::RARA testing is decisive.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, sometimes vacuoles, and folded nuclei, and are nonspecific esterase positive.
Lymphoblasts may look similar but are MPO negative and express B- or T-lineage markers by flow cytometry.

exam.answer_en: AML with mutated NPM1 (suggested) — circulating agranular blasts with cup-shaped pale nuclear invaginations, no Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血見三顆杯狀核母細胞，考官要你說出下一步檢查：NPM1 與 FLT3（ITD、TKD）突變、PML::RARA 排除 APL、karyotype。
臨床特徵：NPM1 突變 AML 常見正常核型、白血球偏高、牙齦或皮膚浸潤（單核球分化時），多為 de novo。
治療連結：FLT3 突變者誘導加 midostaurin（或 FLT3-ITD 用 quizartinib）；復發或不適強化療者可用 venetoclax + hypomethylating agent，NPM1 突變族群反應佳；menin inhibitor 為 NPM1 突變復發難治的新選擇。
MRD：NPM1 mutant transcript qPCR 追蹤，治療後持續陽性或上升預測復發，可引導是否移植。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易誤認為急性單核球白血病或 ALL：單核母細胞胞質較多、灰藍帶空泡且 NSE 陽性；ALL 母細胞更小、胞質極少、MPO 陰性。杯狀核為提示而非確診，最終仍靠分子檢測。

quiz.q: 周邊血出現這種杯狀核母細胞，除 NPM1 外，最需同時檢測的哪個基因會改變誘導治療選擇？
quiz.a: FLT3（ITD 與 TKD），陽性可加 midostaurin 或 quizartinib。

30971.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中箭頭所指的紅血球內各有一顆單一、圓形、深紫色的小點，大小一致且貼近細胞邊緣，這就是 Howell-Jolly 小體，代表脾功能低下（本例為慢性 GVHD 所致）。
features: Single, small, round, dense dark purple inclusions within red cells (arrowheads)
Inclusions are uniform, about 1 micron, and eccentric in position
Red cells otherwise largely normocytic and normochromic with occasional irregular shapes
Scattered platelets in the background, not overlying the red cells
30971.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows several red cells containing a single small, round, dense basophilic inclusion (arrowheads), consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies. The remaining red cells show no significant poikilocytosis, and platelets are present in the background. No parasites or basophilic stippling are seen. Findings are consistent with hyposplenism, here in the setting of chronic graft-versus-host disease.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple fine clustered granules near the periphery that stain with Prussian blue, rather than a single round dense dot.
An overlying platelet is larger, has a pale halo and granular texture and lies in a slightly different focal plane.
Ring forms have a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red chromatin dot, while Howell-Jolly bodies are solid round dots without cytoplasm.
Stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse blue granules distributed throughout the red cell rather than one discrete body.

exam.answer_en: Howell–Jolly bodies indicating hyposplenism in chronic GVHD — single small round dense basophilic inclusions within red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處紅血球內的單一深紫圓點，問名稱與代表意義；答 Howell-Jolly body，為殘留核 DNA，代表脾臟移除功能喪失（hyposplenism）。
成分與染色：DNA 片段，Feulgen 染色陽性、Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 則為含鐵顆粒，鐵染色陽性。
功能性脾低下原因：脾切除、sickle cell disease 自體脾梗塞、celiac disease、慢性 GVHD、SLE、酒精性肝病、類澱粉沉積等。
臨床意義：慢性 GVHD 病人有 encapsulated organisms（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis）重症感染風險，應接種疫苗並考慮抗生素預防；發燒需當急症處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為紅血球上的血小板或 Pappenheimer bodies：血小板較大、有淡色邊與顆粒且焦平面不同；Pappenheimer bodies 為多顆細小、聚在邊緣的顆粒且鐵染色陽性。Howell-Jolly 為單顆、圓且實心緻密。

quiz.q: 慢性 GVHD 病人紅血球內出現這種單一深紫圓點，名稱為何？代表病人需特別預防哪一類感染？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body（功能性脾低下）；莢膜菌感染（如肺炎鏈球菌）。

30779.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中出現多種未成熟顆粒球（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核）、有核紅血球與單核球，呈白血球–紅血球母細胞反應（leukoerythroblastic）樣；在鐮刀型貧血幼童，這可能是 parvovirus 感染恢復期的反應，易被誤認為骨髓增生性腫瘤。
features: Left-shifted granulocytes including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and band and segmented neutrophils with toxic-appearing granulation
Several nucleated red blood cells with condensed dark nuclei
Large immature mononuclear cells and a monocyte with vacuolated cytoplasm
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, occasional target cells and an elongated form, and polychromatophilic cells
Platelets present in the background
30779.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with left-shifted granulocytes, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands, together with circulating nucleated red cells and a few large immature mononuclear cells. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with occasional target and elongated forms and scattered polychromatophilic cells; platelets are present. Frank blasts are not a dominant population in this field, and basophilia is not evident. In a toddler with sickle cell disease, these findings are suggestive of a reactive marrow recovery response to parvovirus B19 infection mimicking a myeloproliferative neoplasm, which should be confirmed with parvovirus PCR/serology and reticulocyte trends.

ddx.vs: JMML shows persistent absolute monocytosis above 1 x 10^9/L, elevated HbF and RAS-pathway mutations rather than a transient left shift after infection.
CML shows a myelocyte bulge with prominent basophilia and eosinophilia and BCR-ABL1 fusion.
These show a significant population of blasts, often megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs, rather than mature left-shifted granulocytes.
Myelophthisis shows persistent teardrop cells and marrow biopsy with infiltrate or fibrosis rather than self-limited changes.

30267.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中三個芽細胞，核大、染色質細緻、細胞質少且深藍，邊緣有明顯淡色泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），旁邊還有一個有核紅血球；這種帶泡狀突起的巨核芽細胞在唐氏症新生兒提示暫時性異常骨髓增生（TAM）。
features: Three blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei and finely granular chromatin
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent pale, platelet-like cytoplasmic blebs
A circulating nucleated red cell with condensed nucleus and polychromatic cytoplasm
Red cells with many stomatocyte-like slit forms, occasional target and fragmented cells
A large platelet and small platelet aggregates in the background
30267.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows circulating blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm bearing prominent pale cytoplasmic blebs, typical of megakaryoblasts. A nucleated red cell and large platelets are also present, and red cells show stomatocyte-like and occasional fragmented forms. No Auer rods are identified. In a neonate with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; immunophenotyping for CD41/CD61 and GATA1 mutation testing are confirmatory.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Blasts look the same, but ML-DS occurs after the neonatal period, does not remit spontaneously and has additional mutations beyond GATA1.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia without Down syndrome
ddx.vs: It lacks trisomy 21 and GATA1 mutations and does not regress spontaneously.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebs and are TdT and B- or T-lineage marker positive.
It shows nucleated red cells and left-shifted granulocytes without a population of blebbed blasts.

exam.answer_en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis — circulating megakaryoblasts with prominent pale cytoplasmic blebs plus a nucleated red cell and large platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指三顆帶淡色胞質突起的母細胞與旁邊的有核紅血球，問細胞辨認與診斷；答 megakaryoblasts，唐氏症新生兒即 TAM。
Flow：CD34、CD117、CD13/CD33 陽性，CD41/CD61/CD42b 陽性，常異常表現 CD7 與 CD56；MPO 陰性。確診並需驗 GATA1 突變。
與反應性新生兒血象區分：敗血症或缺氧可見有核紅血球與左移，但不會有大量具 blebs 的 megakaryoblasts，也無 GATA1 突變。
預後連結：TAM 的 GATA1 突變若在緩解後以高敏感度方法仍可偵測（minimal residual TAM），發展為 ML-DS 的風險較高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易誤認為 ALL 淋巴母細胞：ALL 母細胞無胞質 blebs，flow 表現 TdT 與 B/T 系抗原；本圖母細胞胞質深藍且有淡色類血小板突起，應以 CD41/CD61 確認巨核系。

quiz.q: 此新生兒周邊血的帶 blebs 母細胞，確診 TAM 時應檢測哪一個基因？
quiz.a: GATA1（exon 2 突變）。

29115.recognize_zh: 抹片中許多小而深染、缺乏中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes），箭頭處兩個球形紅血球黏在一起形成 doublet，背景有多染性紅血球，符合自體免疫溶血性貧血。
features: Numerous spherocytes: small, round, densely staining red cells lacking central pallor
Paired spherocytes adhering or overlapping as doublets (arrows), reflecting small red cell aggregates
Scattered larger bluish polychromatophilic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Admixed normochromic red cells with central pallor and occasional teardrop/elongated forms
Neutrophils present; platelets appear adequate without clumping
29115.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous spherocytes, many of which lie in closely adherent pairs (doublet spherocytes), together with polychromatophilic macrocytes consistent with a reticulocyte response. Residual normochromic red cells with central pallor are present, and occasional poikilocytes are seen; large agglutinates, schistocytes and red cell parasites are not identified. Findings are consistent with immune-mediated hemolysis such as warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia, and a direct antiglobulin test is recommended.

ddx.vs: HS shows spherocytes with a negative DAT, family history and abnormal EMA-binding/osmotic fragility, and doublet formation from antibody-mediated aggregation is not expected.
Cold agglutinins produce large irregular red cell clumps that disperse on warming, rather than small pairs of spherocytes, with a C3-positive DAT.

ddx.dx: Overlapping red cells in a thick area of the smear
ddx.vs: Artifactual overlap occurs among normal biconcave cells in thick areas, whereas true doublets here are spherocytes in a thin, well-spread field.
MAHA features schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles) and thrombocytopenia rather than predominant spherocytes.

exam.answer_en: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia — numerous spherocytes including adherent doublet spherocytes with polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著成對黏在一起的小而無中央淡染區的紅血球問「這是什麼？代表什麼？」→ doublet spherocytes，提示抗體媒介的紅血球聚集，屬免疫性溶血。
必做 DAT：warm AIHA 典型為 IgG 陽性（可合併 C3），cold agglutinin disease 則以 C3d 陽性為主。
溶血指標：LDH 上升、haptoglobin 下降、indirect bilirubin 上升、網狀紅血球增加；需找次發原因如 CLL、SLE、藥物。
治療：warm AIHA 第一線為 corticosteroids，rituximab 常用於第二線或與類固醇合併；輸血時血庫配血困難需提早溝通。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 hereditary spherocytosis 混淆；HS 為 DAT 陰性、有家族史、EMA binding 降低，且不會出現抗體造成的 doublet 聚集，靠 DAT 與臨床區分。

quiz.q: 圖中成對黏附的球形紅血球提示哪一類溶血？首先應做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: 免疫性溶血（warm AIHA）；direct antiglobulin test (DAT)

27899.recognize_zh: 高倍下真皮膠原束之間充滿片狀、中至大型芽細胞：核圓至卵圓或略有凹陷、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質淡嗜伊紅，且有多個有絲分裂像——單一型態的芽細胞穿插膠原，符合骨髓肉瘤。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval, focally indented nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Infiltration between and around dermal collagen bundles; no cohesive nests or glands
27899.describe_en: High-power view of the dermal infiltrate shows sheets of discohesive medium-to-large blasts with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified, and the cells percolate between collagen bundles without forming cohesive nests. Occasional cells with more eosinophilic cytoplasm may represent maturing myeloid elements. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma; immunohistochemistry for MPO, lysozyme, CD33, CD34 and CD117 is needed to confirm myeloid lineage.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells have vesicular chromatin with prominent nucleoli and are CD20/PAX5-positive and MPO-negative.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with B- or T-lineage markers, and lack MPO/lysozyme and eosinophilic myelocytes.
Morphologically similar blasts but CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4-positive and MPO-negative.
Carcinoma and melanoma are cytokeratin or S100/SOX10-positive and CD45-negative, often with cohesive growth.

4027.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指紅血球的血紅素被推擠到一側，另一側只剩透明薄膜像水泡（blister cell／偏心細胞），背景還有多個咬痕狀與濃縮變形的紅血球及一個嗜多色性紅血球，符合 G6PD 缺乏症的氧化性溶血。
features: Blister cells: hemoglobin condensed to one side with a clear, membrane-bound peripheral vacuole (arrows)
Eccentrocytes and irregularly contracted, densely staining red cells
Bite-like cells with notched or flattened margins
Polychromatophilic red cell indicating reticulocyte response (small arrow)
Adequate platelets; no agglutination or schistocyte-dominant pattern
4027.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear, membrane-lined peripheral space (blister cells/eccentrocytes), together with bite-like and irregularly contracted dense cells. A polychromatophilic red cell indicates a reticulocyte response. Platelets are adequate and no red cell agglutination is seen. Findings are consistent with acute oxidant hemolysis, as seen in G6PD deficiency; a supravital stain for Heinz bodies and a G6PD assay performed after recovery are recommended.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are round, uniformly dense cells lacking the eccentric clear membrane pocket of blister cells.
MAHA shows sharp-edged schistocytes and helmet cells with thrombocytopenia rather than hemoglobin retracted from an intact membrane.
Unstable hemoglobins also produce Heinz bodies and bite cells, so a normal G6PD assay with a positive isopropanol stability test and Hb analysis separate them.
Artifactual refractile holes occur in many cells in one area with sharp edges and no associated bite cells or polychromasia.

exam.answer_en: Acute oxidant hemolysis (G6PD deficiency) — blister cells/eccentrocytes with bite cells and polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著血紅素縮在一側、另一側透明的紅血球問「這叫什麼？提示什麼？」→ blister cell（eccentrocyte），氧化性溶血，最常見為 G6PD 缺乏。
Heinz bodies 在 Wright 染色看不到，需 supravital（crystal violet 或 brilliant cresyl blue）染色；脾臟移除 Heinz body 形成 bite cell。
G6PD 缺乏為 X-linked；急性溶血期因年輕紅血球（網狀紅血球）酵素活性較高，G6PD 值可能假性正常，應於恢復後複驗。
誘發因子：蠶豆、感染、樟腦丸（naphthalene）、primaquine、dapsone、rasburicase；methylene blue 對 G6PD 缺乏者可能無效並加重溶血。
exam.pitfall_zh: Blister cell 的透明區易被當成乾燥假影或誤認為 spherocyte；假影在同一區大量出現且邊緣銳利，blister cell 有完整膜包圍並伴 bite cells 與多染性紅血球。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指血紅素偏向一側、另一側呈透明膜囊的紅血球叫什麼？應懷疑哪種酵素缺乏？
quiz.a: Blister cell（eccentrocyte）；G6PD deficiency

12539.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中紅血球不規則地黏成大小不一的團塊（紅血球凝集，非串錢狀），同時散布大量中型淋巴樣細胞、染色質中度濃縮、胞質少至中等，提示淋巴增生疾病（本例為前淋巴球白血病）合併冷凝集素溶血。
features: Irregular three-dimensional clumps of red cells of variable size (agglutination) rather than linear rouleaux stacks
Increased medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Some lymphoid cells with a suggestion of a central nucleolus, not well resolved at this magnification
Occasional small dense red cells (possible spherocytes) between clumps
Rare neutrophil present
12539.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent red cell agglutination with irregular clumps of erythrocytes of varying size. There is an increase in medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a modest rim of pale cytoplasm; nucleoli are not clearly resolved at this magnification. Occasional dense spherocyte-like cells are present. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin-mediated hemolysis associated with a lymphoproliferative disorder; in this patient flow cytometry and marrow findings supported B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, and warming the sample to 37 °C should disperse the agglutinates.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are orderly linear stacks of red cells like coins, whereas agglutinates are irregular grape-like clumps that disperse on warming.
