Findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet (acquired Pelger-Huet) neutrophils, which should prompt evaluation for myelodysplastic syndrome or a drug effect (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate).

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset often with hypogranulation and dysplasia in other lineages.
Band forms have a curved, uniformly thick horseshoe nucleus with less condensed chromatin, not two discrete round lobes with coarse clumped chromatin.
Immature myeloid cells have round or kidney-shaped nuclei with finer chromatin and more abundant specific granules.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophils — bilobed pince-nez and non-segmented peanut-shaped nuclei with clumped chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：兩顆中性球分別為眼鏡狀與花生狀核，考官問「這是什麼？合併細胞質顆粒減少提示什麼？」答 pseudo-Pelger-Huët 合併 hypogranulation，兩者皆為 dysgranulopoiesis，要評估 MDS。
MDS 評估：血球低下 + ≥10% 單系形態異常 + 骨髓母細胞比例 + 細胞遺傳學/NGS（如 del(5q)、−7、TP53、SF3B1）。
非腫瘤原因：藥物（mycophenolate、tacrolimus、valproate 等）、HIV、嚴重感染；停藥或病因改善後可恢復。
TP53 突變或 del(17p) 的骨髓腫瘤中，pseudo-Pelger 細胞常較明顯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 band 或遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly；band 染色質較鬆、核呈帶狀，遺傳型幾乎所有中性球均一低分葉且顆粒正常、無血球低下。

quiz.q: 圖中兩顆中性球除低分葉核外，細胞質還有什麼異常？這兩項合起來提示什麼？
quiz.a: 顆粒減少（hypogranulation）；dysgranulopoiesis，需評估 MDS（排除藥物等後天原因）。

1531.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多個大型芽細胞（藍色胞質、細緻染色質），並混有帶橘粉色顆粒胞質的前骨髓細胞與骨髓細胞，呈現「芽細胞加上顆粒球成熟」的組合，這是 t(8;21) AML 常見的有成熟分化型態。
features: Increased blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm, fine chromatin and round to indented nuclei
Admixed maturing granulocytes (promyelocytes, myelocytes) with salmon-pink granular cytoplasm
Some larger granulated cells with abnormal-appearing, poorly condensed nuclei suggesting dysgranulopoiesis
Scattered small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
Prominent red cell rouleaux, likely reflecting a thick smear area
1531.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm and fine nuclear chromatin, accompanied by maturing granulocytic cells including promyelocytes and myelocytes with orange-pink granular cytoplasm. Some granulocytic precursors appear large with abnormal nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation. Scattered lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are present, and red cells show rouleaux, probably related to smear thickness. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation and are compatible with AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1 in the appropriate genetic context.

ddx.vs: APL shows a predominance of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with folded nuclei and Auer rod bundles rather than blasts with orderly granulocytic maturation.
MDS with increased blasts has fewer than 20% blasts, but t(8;21) defines AML regardless of blast count.
Myeloma would show atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs rather than myeloblasts and granulocytic precursors.

exam.answer_en: AML with t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1, with maturation — blasts mixed with maturing granulated promyelocytes and myelocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：圖中芽細胞與成熟中顆粒球並存，考官問「為何不是 MDS」；RUNX1::RUNX1T1 屬 defining genetic abnormality，找到即歸為 AML。
形態線索：顆粒球系常有 dysplasia（pseudo-Pelger、顆粒異常）、橘粉色胞質、eosinophil 前驅增加，易被誤看成 MDS。
確認方法：karyotype 找 t(8;21)(q22;q22.1)，或 FISH/RT-PCR 找 RUNX1::RUNX1T1；此融合可為 cryptic，核型正常時仍需分子檢測。
治療：屬 core-binding factor AML，強化治療含 high-dose cytarabine 療效佳；可考慮加入 gemtuzumab ozogamicin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 MDS with increased blasts（因有成熟與 dysplasia）；只要驗到 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 即診斷 AML，不受芽細胞比例限制（WHO 5th）。

quiz.q: 骨髓中芽細胞偏少但有 dysplasia，若檢出 RUNX1::RUNX1T1，應診斷為何？
quiz.a: AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1（非 MDS）

123.recognize_zh: 骨髓形態只見細胞量增加、紅血球系與三系造血皆存在，並無特異性；真正定診的線索是 Sanger 定序圖中 VHL c.598 位置由 C 變成單一 T 峰（同型合子 c.598C>T），PCR-RFLP 膠片中亦有一條與其他樣本不同的 268 bp 條帶。
features: Aspirate smear with densely packed red cells in the background, reflecting high hematocrit
Cellular marrow particles and a hypercellular trephine with trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes
Clusters of basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts without obvious dysplasia
No morphologic feature on these images that separates congenital from acquired erythrocytosis
Sanger chromatogram: wild-type C peak (upper) versus single homozygous T peak (lower) at VHL c.598
PCR-RFLP gel: one lane with a 268 bp undigested band; other lanes show 187 bp (and faint 81 bp) digested fragments
123.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a densely packed red cell background, cellular particles, and erythroid precursors in clusters admixed with maturing granulocytic cells; no significant dysplasia is evident. The trephine biopsy (H&E) is hypercellular for age with trilineage hematopoiesis and scattered megakaryocytes, without clustering or atypia recognizable at this magnification. Sanger sequencing shows a single T peak at the position occupied by C in the reference trace, indicating homozygous VHL c.598C>T (p.Arg200Trp), and the PCR-RFLP gel shows one sample with an altered restriction pattern (268 bp band) distinct from the digested 187/81 bp pattern of the others. In the setting of erythrocytosis with normal-range erythropoietin and negative family history, findings are consistent with Chuvash polycythemia; the marrow morphology itself is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: Marrow shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic, clustered megakaryocytes and low serum erythropoietin with JAK2 V617F/exon 12 mutation, whereas Chuvash polycythemia is JAK2-negative with normal-to-high EPO and VHL p.Arg200Trp.
Morphology is similarly nonspecific; distinguished by low oxygen saturation, carboxyhemoglobin or elevated EPO from a tumor rather than a germline VHL variant.
Shows a low p50 and often an abnormal HPLC/electrophoresis pattern, whereas HPLC was normal here.
Morphologically identical; separated only by gene sequencing and EPO level (low in EPOR mutation).

captions: Bone marrow composite: aspirate cells (A, C), cellular particle (B) and hypercellular trephine (D)
Sanger sequencing: reference C (top) versus homozygous T (bottom) at VHL c.598
PCR-RFLP agarose gel: 268 bp undigested band in one lane versus 187/81 bp digested fragments

59.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中充滿大量含紫色異染顆粒（metachromatic granules）的大型肥大細胞，許多細胞核呈雙葉或不規則且顆粒散落背景；骨髓切片中片狀淡染細胞呈 tryptase/CD117 陽性並異常表現 CD25 與 CD2，流式也見 CD117 強陽性/CD25+/CD2+ 族群（18%），符合肥大細胞白血病。
features: BM aspirate: sheets of large mast cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse purple metachromatic granules, many degranulated with granules scattered in the background
Atypical mast cells: round to oval, indented, bilobed and binucleated nuclei with open chromatin; variable hypogranulation
BM biopsy: hypercellular marrow with sheets of medium-to-large cells with pale granular cytoplasm and oval/indented nuclei, admixed megakaryocytes
IHC: diffuse sheets positive for tryptase-type granular and membranous CD117 staining; aberrant weak CD25 and CD2 in mast cells
Small bowel: lamina propria diffusely infiltrated by monotonous mast cells between crypts, highlighted by membranous IHC
Flow cytometry: CD117-bright/CD25+ population (18% of events) co-expressing CD2; PB smear shows a circulating granulated mast cell
59.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophilia with an occasional circulating mast cell with scattered metachromatic granules. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by numerous large atypical mast cells with abundant coarse metachromatic granules, many with indented, bilobed or binucleated nuclei, and frequent degranulation into the background. The core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of mast cells with pale granular cytoplasm that are diffusely positive for tryptase and CD117 and aberrantly express CD25 and CD2, and a small-bowel biopsy shows diffuse mucosal infiltration by CD117-positive cells. Flow cytometry identifies a CD117-bright population (18% of events) co-expressing CD25 and CD2. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis, mast cell leukemia (mast cells at least 20% of marrow aspirate nucleated cells).

ddx.vs: ASM has C-findings but mast cells constitute fewer than 20% of nucleated cells on the aspirate smear, unlike the mast-cell-replaced aspirate here.
Basophilic blasts are CD117-negative/dim, CD123+/CD203c+ and tryptase-negative or weak, whereas these cells are CD117-bright and diffusely tryptase-positive.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia or CML with mast cell proliferation
ddx.vs: These show increased but non-sheeting, typically CD25-negative mast cells with a defining BCR::ABL1 or PDGFRA/FGFR1 rearrangement, rather than sheets of CD25+/CD2+ atypical mast cells.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with abundant granules (e.g. APL-like hypergranular blasts)
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts/promyelocytes are MPO-positive, tryptase-negative and lack the CD117-bright/CD25+ mast cell immunophenotype.

59.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC (tryptase, CD117, CD25, CD2), flow

BM biopsy IHC: strong membranous staining of mast cell sheets (likely CD117)
BM biopsy IHC: weak membranous/cytoplasmic staining of mast cells (likely CD25)
BM biopsy IHC: strong small T cells with weak granular staining of a mast cell (likely CD2)
BM aspirate low power: numerous mast cells with metachromatic granules and background degranulation
BM aspirate high power: atypical, bilobed and binucleated mast cells with variable granulation
